A '''mariner''' lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by a galactic company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and Harte Secur was one of the first cities [[Capture of Harte Secur|attacked]], during which the [[Sailor|mariner]] was captured by the Federation. After the Trade Federation had [[Capture of Theed/Legends|taken]] Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], they focused their attention towards defeating the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], an amphibious [[Species/Legends|species]] who coexisted alongside the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] population.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The captive mariner told the Trade Federation [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]]<ref name="End">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> about [[Ganne]], a Gungan [[Boss/Legends|boss]] of the city [[Rellias]], which led the Federation to [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|attack]] Ganne and the rest of the Gungans.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harte Secur mariner was mentioned in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The mariner is mentioned in the objectives section at the start of "The Search for an Underwater Kingdom," the fifth level of the Trade Federation campaign.<ref name="GB" />
